brief:
Israeli military operations continued across the Gaza Strip following a ceasefire that took effect October 10, 2025, IMEMC News reported. Gaza's Health Ministry documented a rising death toll and additional casualties despite the truce agreement, while medical sources confirmed ongoing Israeli military violations in the territory.

The humanitarian situation in Gaza has deteriorated significantly amid the reported violations. Health officials pointed to mounting casualties as a central concern, even as the ceasefire remained officially in place. The continuing operations underscored tensions surrounding the implementation of the agreement and raised questions about adherence to the truce terms.
